trash.card.title: Remove from {app}
trash.card.keeps: Its folder and files stay as they are.
trash.card.goes: Its folder and every file in it go to the {where}.
trash.card.tick: Move its folder to the {where} too
trash.removed: Removed {name}. Its folder is in the {where}.
trash.gone: Its folder is not there any more, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed.
trash.link: Its folder is a link to another folder, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed.
trash.drive: Its folder is a whole drive, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed.
trash.home: Its folder is, or holds, your home folder, or is one of the folders inside it, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed.
trash.cloud: Its folder is a whole cloud drive, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed.
trash.holds_app: Its folder holds the app's own files or settings, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed.
trash.holds_project: Its folder holds another project, {other}, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed.
trash.busy: {name} is being saved right now, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed. Try again in a moment.
trash.open: {name} is open in another window, so nothing was moved to the {where} or removed. Close it there and try again.
trash.no_bin: Its folder is on a drive with no {where}, so nothing was moved or removed.
trash.failed: Its folder could not be moved to the {where}, so {name} stays in the list.
